text_block_list.text:
One day, while having a meal with Symboli 
Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thanks for the food.

On the table, the wrapper from the burger 
she ate was neatly folded into a pristine 
square. Furthermore, there wasn't a single 
smudge around her mouth.
choice_data_list: You even eat hamburgers so neatly, huh?
You eat hamburgers so neatly, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Isn't that normal?
choice_data_list:
Calling that "normal" is a bit of a 
stretch...

text_block_list.text:
Even while eating, her table manners were 
beautiful. When I tell her as much—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... You'll be even more surprised once 
you meet my older siblings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Those two were the absolute paragons of 
etiquette. I used to imitate them all the 
time back in the day.
choice_data_list: So you were the youngest child?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no. I actually have another younger 
sister below me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...In front of her, like Mencius' mother 
moving thrice, I always strove to be the 
best older sister I could."
choice_data_list:
I bet your little sister is a wonderful 
kid, too.

I'm sure your little sister is a great 
girl, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she has grown into such a fine girl. 
However, that is not all there is to her—

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Father
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf, have you decided on your goals for 
this year?

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Father. I decided after consulting 
with Brother and Sister as well!

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Father
text_block_list.text:
I see, then with a prayer in our hearts. 
First, let us bow—

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the part-time shrine maiden! 
Working again today~?

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Wh... I-I'm sorry! Hey now, the shrine 
maiden lady is working. You shouldn't 
bother her.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't mention it~. Still, you 
remembered what we talked about last year 
so well. Are you going to draw a fortune 
slip after praying, too?

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Low-angle shot! Ehehe, sis, you really 
remembered all about me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The moment you take your eyes off my 
little sister, she dashes off somewhere 
and comes back having made a new friend. 
Her cheerful nature is wonderful, but..."

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Hup, ho! Big sis! Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So that's where you were...! W-Why are you 
dancing with a lion dance troupe!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...She was often at the center of trouble, 
too. Because of that, whenever I went out 
with my little sister, I usually ended up 
holding her hand the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. She's quite the free-spirited 
little sister, isn't she? Though thanks to 
that—
(Crash!!)

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: "Mommy! The water flew away!"

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! I am so terribly sorry!! Did it get 
on your clothes... Wait, y-your shoes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No. Something like this is no problem at 
all. They're quite the energetic child, 
aren't they?
(Click! Clatter, clatter, clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mommy, my spoon dropped too.

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Why'd you throw it?! Jeez, please, 
just stay still...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Hey there. Got a moment?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...*hop* *hop* *hop*

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Your ears?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: ! Hop!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hop, hop, hop. On your lap?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hop!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Would you like to sit on my 
lap while we wait for food?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hop! Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you were a girl who loved hand 
games, weren't you?
choice_data_list:
You were pretty good at soothing them 
yourself.

You were really good at soothing them, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, I guess that's thanks to my little 
sister. Back then, it was daily trial and 
error trying to figure out how to get her 
to sit still."
choice_data_list: …You're such a kind lady, aren't you.
You'd make such a kind mother.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, I guess that's thanks to my little 
sister. Back then, it was daily trial and 
error trying to figure out how to get her 
to sit still."
choice_data_list: …You're such a kind lady, aren't you.
You'd make such a kind mother.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I understand that there are 
times when one must be strict.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Because innocent children are always 
the most adorable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, a "mother", huh? When I become a 
mother, is it...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: .............Yeah. ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet there is a saying that an indulgent 
mother spoils the child. If it were your 
own daughter, who's to say?

Symboli Rudolf chuckled, as if making a 
joke.
